heading: New researchers.
intro: ERS–WVSU creates space for students to explore meaningful research questions, learn empirical methods, and connect with faculty around economics-centered projects.
spotlight_intro: A curated space for student-led and student-supported research that connects economic questions, evidence, and interdisciplinary inquiry.
spotlight_empty_title: Your research could be featured here.
spotlight_empty_text: Student projects will appear here after review and permission to share. We welcome abstracts, posters, research notes, and collaborative work.
mentorship_intro: Students can explore research questions, methodological challenges, and possible faculty guidance through the ERS–WVSU seminar community. Opportunities depend on available faculty capacity and project fit.
closing_text: Students interested in economic reasoning, data analysis, or credible impact evaluation are welcome to introduce a project or ask how to get started.
